full_judgment: 2. Facts relevant for disposal of the Rule are that the opposite party as plaintiff instituted Other Class Suit No. 67 of 2002 seeking for declaration of title in the suit land on the strength of an alleged settlement (pattan) dated 11th Chaitra, 1341 BS. It was the plaintiffs case that after taking pattan he was put in possession and thereafter paid rent by as many as 14 rent receipts but the RS record was not prepared and, as such, the suit.
